text:
Four power banks in the search results advertise Qi2 25W wireless charging. Two have US purchase pages.

**Available to buy now**

| Power bank | Capacity | Wired output | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Baseus PicoGo AM52](https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w) | 10,000 mAh | 45W USB-C | $79.99 on Amazon US. $59.99 on Baseus's site, or $53.99 with code AM52 (a code Dealectric says it tested on 2026-10-24) |
| [Anker MagGo 2 Pro (A110R)](https://www.anker.com/products/a110r-qi2-maggo-2-pro-magnetic-power-bank?Sort_by=Recommended&collections_anker-earth-day-sale-2026=&variant=46550444277910) | 10,000 mAh | 45W USB-C | $109.99 |

- **Baseus PicoGo AM52:** It is Qi2.2 certified. The 25W speed works on iPhone 16 and 17 models (not the 16e). Older iPhones (12–15) get 15W. It recharges at 30W in about 1.5 hours. The link is an affiliate link, so Dealectric earns a commission at no cost to you. Sources: [Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w), [Notebookcheck](https://www.notebookcheck.net/Baseus-launches-new-Qi2-2-25W-certified-10-000-mAh-power-bank-with-slim-design.1223437.0.html).
- **Anker MagGo 2 Pro:** It adds a built-in cooling fan, a smart display, a stand and 45W recharging. It is a pre-order shipping Oct 21 – Nov 9, 2026. It is for Apple devices only, and Anker lists 25W alongside iPhone 13–17 compatibility.

**Announced, but I couldn't confirm US purchase pages**
- **UGREEN MagFlow Magnetic Power Bank:** UGREEN says it was the first Qi 2.2-certified power bank, with 25W charging. The July 2025 [press release](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/ugreen-pioneers-next-gen-wireless-charging-with-magflow-25w-the-worlds-first-qi-2-2-certified-power-bank-302505385.html) promised a Q3 2025 launch on UGREEN's site and Amazon. The results had no current price or product page.
- **ESR MagSlim (10,000 mAh):** At 13.8 mm thick, ESR calls it the thinnest Qi2 25W power bank. It was previewed at CES 2026 and is optimized for iPhone 17. See the [press release](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/esr-expands-its-qi2-25w-wireless-charging-lineup-advancing-everyday-charging-at-ces-2026-302653572.html). Check ESR's site or Amazon for current availability.

A Japanese model, the CIO SMARTCOBY Ex05 Wireless2.2 Pro, also exists, but it was announced for Japan only.

For the best value, the Baseus is cheaper. The Anker costs more but adds active cooling.
